entities.summary: Robert "Rob" Karl Baldwin Grabert is a retired volleyball player from the Netherlands who represented his home country at the 1988 and 1996 Summer Olympics. His finest hour came in 1996, when he won the gold medal in Atlanta with the Dutch men's national team by defeating archrivals Italy in the final (3–2).
